texts.label: R190, Portogallo 8 ff. 92r-95r (George Lasry's DECODE decryption)
texts.summary: A letter in the Portugal nunciature cipher, with a passage 'Al conte di Desmon[d]' on the soldiers of His Holiness in Ireland; undated, filed between Sauli's and Riario's runs. Lasry's decryption file (DECODE D3249, Oct 2020, on Midas's 2017 transcription) covers R190 and R191 together.
texts.note: Lasry's DECODE decryption of Midas's 2017 transcription: sign-by-sign rows with ?-marks (474 of 2,392 groups uncertain) and only fragments of the clear text and glosses; no coherent sentence can be assembled. The contemporary interlinear decipherment on the leaves has not been transcribed in full (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).

texts.label: R192, Portogallo 8 ff. 195-197, Riario, Nov-Dec 1580
texts.summary: Cardinal Riario, legate to Philip II, reports the Pope's warning of a plot 'sopra il negotio di Piamonte' (the Marquis of Ayamonte, the Anselmi, Huguenots of the Dauphiné), which Philip II answers with thanks and the promise that nothing will disturb Italy; pp. 5-6 are a copy dated 29 Nov 1580.
texts.note: Per-passage working table: digit readings marked 'rough', decrypts with [...] holes in nearly every line, gloss fragments and paraphrased clear-text summaries; the contemporary interlinear decipherment is transcribed only in fragments, so no continuous text can be built (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026).

texts.label: R193, Portogallo 8 ff. 236-238, Riario to Cardinal di Como, Badajoz 2 [Oct?] 1580 and Elvas, Dec 1580
texts.summary: Idiáquez answers for Philip II on the 'impresa d'Inghilterra' requested in the Pope's name: the King lacks the means and defers it until Flanders is subdued. A clear decifrato on p. 3, dated Elvas, December 1580, says the President 'è pietra scandali et mal sodisfatto della Corte romana'.

texts.label: R194, Portogallo 8 f. 281, Riario, 1580-81
texts.summary: Undated and unsigned, in Riario's hand: the Irish captains, money, Flanders first, and the truce; the Italian troops embarked on the Lisbon river are to be sent back toward Italy.
